rule: GOAL: Move the purple block to the blue core using limited actions. CONTROLS: Click a valid dot on the track to shift the block stepwise. RULE: The block moves exactly six cells per click along the diagonal path. TRAP: Assuming larger steps work; clicking too far fails and wastes actions.

GOAL: Extend the yellow bar rightward so its red marker reaches the red plus sign. CONTROLS: Clicking the yellow bar extended it one unit to the right. RULE: The bar stops automatically if it hits the blue obstacle wall. TRAP: Thinking the bar could pass through or overlap the plus to complete the level.

GOAL: Navigate the grid to reach the final room using the shortest path. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move one room per step; plan ahead to minimize moves. RULE: Only open corridors allow passage; walls block movement completely. TRAP: Assuming all gray tiles are walkable; some are decorative or blocked, causing wasted turns.

GOAL: Align the moving white edge precisely with the fixed wall to complete the connection. CONTROLS: Click the upper blue piston to expand the white space leftward; click the lower blue to reverse the motion. RULE: The level finishes only when the white area touches the wall's specific left boundary at column 20. TRAP: Assuming you must maximize the white area; overshooting the alignment causes the mechanism to miss the target and fail.

GOAL: Align five tokens downward to fill the socket. CONTROLS: Click stems to toggle direction, bars to toggle activity, and the button to execute moves. RULE: Dark stems move down, light stems move left. TRAP: Bar color does not determine direction; only stem color matters.

GOAL: Split a single block into two separate pieces to reach two distant cups. CONTROLS: Arrow keys moved the block horizontally; spacebar dropped it straight down. RULE: Blocks split into two halves upon landing, moving away from each other until hitting walls. TRAP: Believing the blocks would merge back together or bounce off cup walls instead of sliding past them.

GOAL: Cycle each slot’s shape to match the target pattern shown above. CONTROLS: Left/Right arrows select the active slot; Up arrow rotates that slot to the next shape in its cycle. RULE: Each slot cycles through a fixed set of seven shapes; pressing Up advances one step forward. TRAP: Assuming all slots share the same shape cycle; they do not, so check each slot’s unique sequence.

GOAL: Align the key's green tip with the slot on the right wall. CONTROLS: Click the blue area below the lower wall to expand the bottom white region. RULE: Expanding one region shrinks its neighbor, moving the attached key rightward. TRAP: Believing the middle region vanishes permanently; it only shrinks until the key reaches the target.

GOAL: Collect blue and orange blocks using a segmented tail. CONTROLS: Left/Right arrows extend or retract the tail segments. RULE: Tail tips pass through blocks to collect them, even if attached blocks are blocked from moving. TRAP: Assuming the tail stops extending when attached blocks hit a wall or other blocks.

GOAL: Place boxes into matching slots. CONTROLS: Arrows move; Space picks up or drops. RULE: Attaching leaves the box stationary, not shifted by the player's position. TRAP: Assuming attach moves the box up caused a double-down error, pushing it out of the slot.

GOAL: Grow the green bar to reach the plus symbol. CONTROLS: Click the sky to raise the ground, click yellow to widen the gap, click green to extend the bar. RULE: The sky must rise high enough so the yellow and green bars do not touch the red pillars. TRAP: You do not need to clear the plus symbol; the green bar can pass through it to land the marker.

GOAL: Reach the green target by clearing the red block from the corridor. CONTROLS: Arrows move the player one step in the chosen direction. RULE: Walking into the red block collects it, removing the obstacle. TRAP: Assuming the red block is a deadly enemy or pushable box rather than a simple pickup.

GOAL: Match every slot's shape to the target examples shown at the top. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the cursor; Up or Down rotates the selected shape. RULE: Rotation does not matter; only the shape's identity needs to match the target. TRAP: Believing specific orientations are required causes wasted cycles, as any rotation counts as a match.

GOAL: Translate a sequence of yellow symbols into blue symbols using hidden word pairings. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor and rotate individual blue symbols to match the target pattern. RULE: Split the yellow row into known word groups, then output the corresponding blue symbols for each group in order. TRAP: Assuming symbols must match exactly; rotation is allowed, so rotate each blue symbol until it fits the required shape.

GOAL: Raise liquid columns to reach specific wall slots. CONTROLS: Four buttons push liquid up in paired adjacent regions. RULE: Keys must align horizontally with slots in the shared wall. TRAP: Thinking regions fill independently; pushing one button changes two levels at once.

GOAL: Fill the grid with a diamond pattern to transfer it to the plug. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor; actions place blocks to form the shape. RULE: Completing the target pattern charges the plug, shrinking its cap to fit through narrow gaps. TRAP: Believing the cap’s blinking size was permanent; it only shrinks after a successful pattern transfer.

GOAL: Move two matching pieces to the same spot to merge them into the target zone. CONTROLS: Clicking near a piece moves it toward that click; clicking where both pieces land merges them. RULE: Pieces move only if the click is within their specific range limit. TRAP: Assuming a single click could merge distant pieces, wasting moves on invalid attempts instead of stepping them closer.

GOAL: Shrink the block to pass the narrow shaft. CONTROLS: Clicks paint cells; arrows move the block. RULE: Painting the white gap transfers mass, shrinking the block from four to two squares wide. TRAP: Pushing the large block up first wastes turns, as it cannot fit through the two-square claw gap until shrunk.

GOAL: Chain pairs to find the final target glyph for each slot. CONTROLS: Arrows move cursor and rotate glyphs to match examples. RULE: Match input to left side, take right side as new left, repeat until target. TRAP: Assuming mirroring was allowed; only rotation matched the example pairs here.

GOAL: Guide the block through the narrow passage to dock with the handle. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the block four units per press. RULE: The block fits the handle only when aligned with the interior grid. TRAP: Moving down before aligning horizontally causes a collision with the shaft walls.

GOAL: Match the top row's hollow color sequence by placing bottom tokens into empty slots. CONTROLS: Click a bottom token to select it, then click a slot to place it. RULE: The hollow squares at the top define the required order, not the solid ones below. TRAP: Assuming the bottom row's current order is correct wastes time; the goal sequence is distinct.

GOAL: Move two shapes to specific top-left corners. CONTROLS: Click the grid to shift pieces step-by-step. RULE: Pieces move a fixed distance toward your click; verify position after each step. TRAP: Assuming clicks teleport pieces instantly; they actually slide incrementally, so overshooting wastes moves.

GOAL: Navigate the grid to reach the green goal while eliminating all red enemies blocking the path. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move your character one tile at a time in the chosen direction. RULE: Move perpendicularly into a red enemy's side to destroy it instantly. TRAP: Thinking you can destroy enemies by facing them or approaching from behind; this causes instant death.

GOAL: Use crosses to cover all colored dots. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active cross; Space switches between blue and yellow crosses. RULE: Dots vanish only when fully covered by their matching color. TRAP: Assuming Space rotates or resets; it actually toggles control, so ignore it until switching colors is needed.

GOAL: Move the yellow block to the highlighted top-left corner. CONTROLS: Click the left red plus to rotate the ring counter-clockwise. RULE: Each click shifts the ring one slot; four shifts reach the target. TRAP: Assuming the highlight marks the current position rather than the destination.

GOAL: Place the block inside the ring. CONTROLS: Click moves the white piece; the block snaps to the midpoint between white and gray. RULE: The block always centers between the two moving pieces. TRAP: Thinking you must move the block directly; you only steer it by positioning the other two.

GOAL: Guide the cursor to collect all orange dots using limited moves. CONTROLS: Arrow keys shift the cursor; Space switches the active color target. RULE: Each key press moves the cursor exactly three grid spaces in that direction. TRAP: Assuming dots vanish upon collection; blue and red dots persist until specifically targeted, confusing color states.

GOAL: Make the highlighted panel match the target pattern shown in its center icon. CONTROLS: Click individual cells to toggle their color between blue and red. RULE: The center icon displays the required final state, where white means red and grey means blue. TRAP: Assuming the icon shows the current state rather than the goal, causing you to ignore the necessary changes.

GOAL: Reduce the scattered pegs down to a single survivor. CONTROLS: Click a peg to select it, then click the highlighted landing spot to jump. RULE: Pegs jump over an adjacent neighbor into an empty hole, removing the jumped peg. TRAP: Assuming random moves work; you must plan three specific jumps to avoid getting stuck.

GOAL: Set each cell so the board matches the pattern shown in its overlapping thumbnail previews. CONTROLS: Clicking a cell cycles its color between blue and orange to match the target. RULE: Each thumbnail displays the 3x3 grid centered on itself, including cells shared by adjacent thumbnails. TRAP: Assuming thumbnails show only isolated cells ignores the overlapping windows that constrain shared rows.

GOAL: Place yellow pieces on two specific target cells by sliding rows. CONTROLS: Red arrows shift rows forward; green arrows shift them backward. RULE: Each click rotates a full row of positions, wrapping ends to start. TRAP: Assuming green shifts left when it actually shifts right, causing wasted moves.

GOAL: Collect the white plus marker to match the target shape displayed in the top room. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the block one tile; walls block movement. RULE: Collecting the plus mirrors the block’s shape to align with the room’s target. TRAP: Assuming the yellow bar is a step limit; it is actually a real-time timer.

GOAL: Move the white core into the left socket. CONTROLS: Arrows move the shell; clicking a shell swaps cores. RULE: Only the white core can move the shell it occupies. TRAP: Docking is permanent; you cannot un-dock to retrieve the core.

GOAL: Move three shapes to cover scattered dots. CONTROLS: Arrows move selected shape; Space switches shape. RULE: Each shape has a unique reach pattern; match the pattern to the dot cluster. TRAP: Moving a shape away from a covered dot uncovers it, resetting progress.

GOAL: Turn all target cells orange to match the hidden pattern revealed by overlapping thumbnails. CONTROLS: Click any grid cell to toggle its color between red and orange. RULE: A thumbnail’s border color dictates its mapping: white cells become that border color, gray cells become the other. TRAP: Assuming a fixed color mapping for all thumbnails; the rule actually changes based on each thumbnail’s specific border color.

GOAL: Arrange colored tokens into two rows to match the target pattern revealed by the pipe mechanism. CONTROLS: Click a token to select it, click a destination slot to swap them, and press Space to confirm the solution. RULE: Tokens swap positions when placed into occupied slots, allowing you to cycle pieces into their correct order. TRAP: Assuming placement pushes tokens aside; it actually swaps them, so you must re-select the displaced piece each turn.

GOAL: Place colored tokens into nested boxes to spell a hidden word. CONTROLS: Click bottom tokens to select, click empty slots to place, press space to finish. RULE: Reading jumps to a sub-box’s leftmost slot, moves right, then returns to the main box. TRAP: Assuming reading continues from the aligned slot instead of resetting to the leftmost position.

GOAL: Move two colored blocks to opposite sides by navigating them through a shared center. CONTROLS: Click to rotate left or right diagonal rings, shifting all blocks along their paths. RULE: Blocks swap positions only when passing through the two central intersection cells. TRAP: Trying to move blocks independently; they are locked to their rings until crossing the middle.

GOAL: Place colored tokens into two linked boxes to form a valid sequence. CONTROLS: Click a token to pick it up, then click a slot to place it. Press space to confirm the solution. RULE: The fixed symbol in the first slot dictates the starting position of the sequence in the legend. TRAP: Assuming the fixed symbol was merely decorative rather than a strict anchor for the sequence order.

GOAL: Fit six tokens into matching slots by placing connectors and colors. CONTROLS: Click a token to select, click a slot to place; press space to submit. RULE: Connectors must bridge matching colors, leaving unique tokens for remaining spots. TRAP: Ignoring that placing one connector shifts available space for the second.

GOAL: Place three blocks so their footprints avoid blue obstacles. CONTROLS: Click to move the selected block to a valid center. RULE: A block occupies a five-by-five square with the four corners removed. TRAP: Assuming a diamond shape allowed moves that actually blocked corners.

ESTABLISHED: Two blocks sit in an arch maze with a solid central wall. Mirrored controls move them left and right. FAILED: Placing blocks at the top, merging them at the top center, and pressing space to submit did not clear the level. GOAL IS NOT: Simply bringing both blocks to the top corridor or merging them in the center. CONTROLS: Left and right arrows move blocks horizontally. Space does nothing. Up and down arrows are unused.

GOAL: Decode overlapping clues to reveal hidden colors and paint the grid. CONTROLS: Click cells to cycle colors; drag to place clue cards over specific areas. RULE: Each card reveals the true color pattern for its covered region, allowing you to deduce the rest. TRAP: Assuming clues show current colors rather than the target solution causes endless contradictory clicks.

GOAL: Guide both blocks to the top corridor and merge them into a single unit. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move individual blocks; Spacebar attempts to confirm the solution. RULE: The archway only closes when both blocks occupy the central top section simultaneously. TRAP: Assuming physical proximity triggers victory; you must explicitly press Spacebar to submit the merged state.

GOAL: Move the pink plus to two specific spots to turn it orange. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the plus one step per press. RULE: The plus changes color when its arms touch a matching colored swatch. TRAP: The white center marker is often hidden by other shapes, so rely on the plus's current color for positioning.

GOAL: Place every colored connector into its matching box slot. CONTROLS: Click a token to select it, then click a slot to place or swap. RULE: Connectors only fit slots of the exact same color and shape. TRAP: Assuming empty gray slots are interchangeable; they are fixed positions, not a shared pool.

GOAL: Move yellow and orange tokens to target zones. CONTROLS: Clicks shifted row or column cycles in two directions. RULE: Shared center cells make row and column shifts non-commutative. TRAP: Assuming shifts cancel out perfectly, ignoring the shared cell interaction.

ESTABLISHED: A gray block spawns and moves left one node per turn, vanishing at the left edge. Blue moves normally with arrows. FAILED: Assuming the gray block mirrors player controls or spawns only from player departure cells. GOAL IS NOT: Controlling the gray block directly or matching its movement pattern. CONTROLS: Arrows move the blue player; the gray block acts as an independent projectile moving left each turn.

GOAL: Turn all grid cells to the target color. CONTROLS: Clicking a plain cell toggles only itself; clicking a special cell toggles a plus shape. RULE: Special cells must be clicked if they start wrong, as nothing else affects them. TRAP: Believing plain cells can fix special cells wastes moves, forcing you to click specials first.

GOAL: Place two diamond handles to guide blocks into green and purple rings. CONTROLS: Click empty spaces to place handles; blocks slide until hitting a wall or handle. RULE: Handles stop blocks exactly where their diamond shape intersects the target ring center. TRAP: Assuming handles block all movement; they only stop blocks when the diamond tip touches the block edge.

GOAL: Move all shells to matching sockets. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active shell; clicks select a new shell. RULE: A shell becomes active only when its core is white; black cores mean locked. TRAP: Trying to move a shell with a black core wastes actions; click it first to activate.

GOAL: Guide the plug to the socket by aligning its red tips with the exposed contacts. CONTROLS: Arrows move the plug three steps per press; the space bar rotates it ninety degrees. RULE: Only arrows consume no energy, so position the plug first, then rotate to face the socket. TRAP: Rotating before moving causes the plug to drift away from the target, wasting precious turns.

GOAL: Slide the charcoal piece onto the yellow target. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the piece, but left and right inputs were reversed due to the mirror. RULE: The divider acts as a mirror; the black shape on the left reflects the charcoal piece on the right. TRAP: Assuming standard controls wasted time, as pressing left actually moved the piece right.

GOAL: Align the yellow handle with the yellow gap in the black bar. CONTROLS: Left-click moves the upper gray edge right; right-click moves it left. RULE: The handle stays fixed; only the boundary moves to meet the target. TRAP: Assuming the handle moves when you actually shift the background edge.

GOAL: Reach the yellow target by navigating a grid of colored blocks. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player; clicking toggles rotates red blocks or shifts blue blocks to new slots. RULE: You must stand on the dark red pivot point to safely toggle adjacent blocks without getting crushed. TRAP: Assuming blue blocks are solid walls; they are actually passable, allowing shortcuts through their original positions.

GOAL: Navigate the grid to the North marker using exactly sixteen moves. CONTROLS: Arrow keys moved the player token across the board. RULE: Movement was only possible between white spaces separated by green gaps. TRAP: Believing you could jump over blue blockers or use non-green intermediate cells.

GOAL: Align the reflected player shape with the yellow target shape. CONTROLS: Arrows move the player or the divider; SPACE switches control mode. RULE: The divider acts as a mirror; moving it shifts the reflection twice as far. TRAP: Ignoring that the reflection moves at double speed relative to the divider causes overshooting.

GOAL: Align the sliding handle with the fixed target slot. CONTROLS: Click arrows to shift horizontal bars left or right. RULE: White space is a limited resource; moving one bar consumes space elsewhere. TRAP: Believing bars move independently; they share a single movement budget, so plan moves to preserve space.

GOAL: Push three boxes into the marked slots to fill the meter. CONTROLS: Arrows move the player and push boxes when adjacent; Space grabs or drops a held box. RULE: Boxes must align perfectly with the target row to count as placed. TRAP: You cannot push a box while holding another; you must drop the first box before grabbing the second.

GOAL: Guide the plug to the socket using five toggle switches. CONTROLS: Click keys to change switch states, then press the pulse button to send power. RULE: Activating a full T-shape switch moves the plug one step downward. TRAP: Assuming all switches affect movement equally, ignoring that only specific shapes trigger vertical travel.

ESTABLISHED: The card requires a white top and purple bottom. Ink flows around obstacles, leaving pockets unfilled. Purple dyeing works, but the flow pattern is complex and hard to predict. FAILED: Randomly sweeping purple ink at ±45 degrees failed to cleanly cover the bottom half without affecting the top or leaving gaps. GOAL IS NOT: Simply matching the visible card image exactly if the mechanics prevent a clean horizontal split. CONTROLS: Arrow keys rotate the cup. Number keys select ink color. Space presses the cup to pour ink in the current direction.

GOAL: Raise bars to match target heights without exceeding adjacent limits. CONTROLS: Click buttons between columns to shift height from one bar to the other. RULE: A bar cannot rise higher than the top of its neighboring bars. TRAP: Assuming bars can rise freely to targets; they stop when blocked by shorter neighbors.

ESTABLISHED: The boat floats in water and rises automatically when aligned with a clear vertical path. Black structures block movement; specific blocks dissolve on contact. The pink goal is in the upper water section. FAILED: Moving straight up from the current center hits a solid black barrier. Assuming the world remains static after dissolving blocks is incorrect; water levels shift. GOAL IS NOT: Located in the bottom water band or reachable by direct upward travel from the current position. CONTROLS: Horizontal movement shifts the boat; vertical travel is passive buoyancy. Contact dissolves

GOAL: Move the divider line up eight rows to fit two pieces into the yellow target zone. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the selected object. Space cycled selection between the line, left piece, and right piece. RULE: Only the selected object responds to arrow keys; unselected objects remain stationary. TRAP: Assuming dots turn white when a piece is selected. Pieces over targets show yellow dots, hiding the selection indicator.

GOAL: Guide the boat through water to the pink target pocket. CONTROLS: Click blocks to dissolve them; arrow keys move the boat horizontally. RULE: The boat only rises when a clear vertical shaft connects it to the surface. TRAP: Moving the boat before clearing the overhead barrier causes it to hit the ceiling and stall.

GOAL: Place two pieces on top targets while their mirror images land on bottom targets. CONTROLS: Arrows move selected item; Space cycles selection between pieces and the mirror line. RULE: Mirror symmetry means top and bottom targets must match opposite poses. TRAP: Assuming pieces must stay below the mirror line; they must cross it to align with the flipped bottom targets.

ESTABLISHED: The dial displays six values matching the legend outputs plus one extra distractor. The correct value for each slot corresponds to the legend output of the pair matching the blue glyph. FAILED: Blindly rotating the dial without identifying the specific target value for the current slot. GOAL IS NOT: Matching the distractor value or using a value from a non-matching legend pair. CONTROLS: The bracket moves between slots. The dial rotates through values. The blue glyph indicates which legend pair to reference.

GOAL: Slide the purple orb along a diagonal line of dots to reach the gray core. CONTROLS: Click the next dot in the chain to swap positions with your orb. RULE: You can only move to the immediately adjacent dot in the sequence. TRAP: Thinking you could click the final target directly; you must traverse every intermediate dot.

GOAL: Match blue glyphs to legend pairs to set correct dial values across six slots. CONTROLS: Arrows navigate slots and adjust dial values; rotation and reflection checks validate glyph matches. RULE: Each slot’s correct dial value is the legend output corresponding to the blue glyph’s input pair. TRAP: Assuming any d8 symmetry match suffices; only pure rotations are valid, while reflections create false positives.

GOAL: Reach the green block while avoiding the sliding guard. CONTROLS: Arrows slide you until you hit a wall or obstacle. RULE: The guard only attacks if you land in its row, with no walls between you. TRAP: Trying to swap with the guard by moving into its column; it does not move vertically, so you just die.

GOAL: Match the top sequence's colors into the empty slots below. CONTROLS: Click a color button to select it, then click a slot to place it. RULE: Fill slots strictly left-to-right to match the top pattern. TRAP: Assuming slots fill in any order or that clicking a slot without selecting a color works.

GOAL: Arrange four shapes to match the target sequence. CONTROLS: Arrows select a slot; Up/Down rotates the shape within that slot. RULE: The target shape is valid in any rotation, so match the silhouette, not the exact angle. TRAP: Rotating the wrong slot or over-rotating past the correct match wastes actions and breaks the sequence.

GOAL: Guide the falling magenta block into the yellow container below. CONTROLS: Arrow keys shift the blue platform; Space releases the hanging block. RULE: The blue platform catches the block, carrying it until Space drops it. TRAP: Assuming arrows move the block directly wastes time; you must manipulate the platform instead.

GOAL: Combine glyph chunks to match a specific color pattern. CONTROLS: Arrows moved or selected puzzle pieces. RULE: Each color sequence in the legend defined a unique chunk value. TRAP: Assuming the order of chunks was fixed rather than freely rearrangeable.

GOAL: Extend both plugs so their dots land exactly on the center of each plus sign. CONTROLS: Click the outer socket to extend a plug; click the inner socket to retract it. RULE: A connection is made only when a plug’s dot aligns precisely with a plus’s center pixel. TRAP: Extending the plug to cover the entire plus symbol does not count as a connection.

GOAL: Chain blue inputs through pink intermediates to find the correct yellow outputs. CONTROLS: Use arrow keys to navigate and select the matching yellow glyph for each slot. RULE: Follow the two-step transformation: Blue maps to Pink, then Pink maps to Yellow. TRAP: Ignoring rotation; the intermediate pink shape must match the second rule’s input, even if rotated.

GOAL: Move two plus-shaped cursors so their arms cover specific colored dots on the grid. CONTROLS: Arrow keys shift the active cursor; Space toggles between the two cursors. RULE: Each cursor arm must align perfectly with its corresponding dot coordinates to win. TRAP: Believing both cursors needed simultaneous positioning; solving one color first often ends the level instantly.

GOAL: Place the moving bead exactly on the target ring. CONTROLS: Click empty space to move white piece; click gray piece to swap positions. RULE: The bead always sits at the midpoint between the white and gray pieces. TRAP: Trying to drag the bead directly; it only moves as a consequence of piece placement.

GOAL: Merge pairs into larger blocks and move them to target dots. CONTROLS: Click to move blocks within range; clicking near two merges them. RULE: Merged blocks center exactly on the click point, not the collision spot. TRAP: Assuming blocks stay put if out of range; they move to the click instead.

GOAL: Align the ring, X, and plus so the ring passes through all red target dots. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the selected shape; Spacebar switches which shape is active. RULE: Shapes move independently, but the ring must physically intersect the fixed dot locations to clear the level. TRAP: Assuming moving the ring alone solves the puzzle; you must reposition the X and plus to make the ring's path valid.

GOAL: Slide the plug tip left until it connects with the socket head. CONTROLS: Left and Right arrows move the tip along the wire; other keys are unused. RULE: Each Left press shifts the tip four columns closer to the goal. TRAP: Assuming the keypad was interactive wasted time; ignore it and focus solely on alignment.

ESTABLISHED: The plug is at the top edge. A block sits directly below it, blocking downward movement. FAILED: Moving down is blocked by the adjacent block. Side shifts did not clear the path. GOAL IS NOT: The goal is not simply reaching the bottom row; blocks must align in specific columns. CONTROLS: Up moves the plug up. Down is blocked if a block is below. Left and right shift the plug horizontally.

GOAL: Lift the plug through a locked collar to reach the target ring. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the plug; clicking keypad cells enters the sequence. RULE: Entering the correct keypad pattern releases the lock, allowing the plug to rise freely. TRAP: Pressing UP before entering the code is useless; the collar remains sealed until the sequence is matched.

GOAL: Route the ring through the pipe to the green section to reveal the hidden color code. CONTROLS: Click pieces to swap slots; press space to test the solution. RULE: The pipe diverts flow to green, leaving the final red slot empty until last. TRAP: Assuming red slots fill strictly left-to-right ignores the pipe’s junction logic.

GOAL: Move three objects to their target spots. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected piece; Space switches to the next piece. RULE: Pressing Space cycles selection among the three objects in a fixed order. TRAP: Assuming Space selects the nearest piece; it actually cycles regardless of distance.

GOAL: Match the target shape to unlock the exit. CONTROLS: Arrows move the block; a pickup rotates its orientation. RULE: The door opens only when your block’s shape matches the target icon. TRAP: Assuming movement alone suffices; ignoring the rotation mechanic blocks progress forever.

GOAL: Fill each colored box with matching pieces, following the path order. CONTROLS: Click a palette piece, then a slot to place it; press SPACE to finish. RULE: The path connects boxes via colored ports, dictating the sequence you must fill. TRAP: Ignoring the port colors and filling boxes left-to-right breaks the required chain.

GOAL: Route a continuous color strip through two linked boxes by inserting a special connector piece. CONTROLS: Click a palette item, then click an empty slot to place it; press Space to run the check. RULE: The connector bridges the red and green zones, allowing the single sequence to flow uninterrupted between them. TRAP: Assuming the connector belongs in the green box; it must go in the red side to start the chain.

GOAL: Align the yellow block with the highlighted frame to clear the level. CONTROLS: Click the red arrow to rotate the ring counterclockwise, moving blocks left along the top. RULE: The yellow bracket frame marks the exact slot where the yellow block must land. TRAP: Mistaking the frame for a static decoration or entry point instead of the precise target location.

GOAL: Plug the tip into the pink socket, ignoring the blocked blue head. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the tip; clicking the panel loaded the white pattern. RULE: Pressing the loaded pattern boosted the tip straight through the collar into the socket. TRAP: Trying to reach the blue head wasted time, as its path was permanently burnt.

GOAL: Arrange pieces so two separated blocks of three match perfectly. CONTROLS: Click palette pieces to place them; click grid slots to set boundary markers; press space to validate. RULE: The sequence must split into two identical three-piece groups separated by the markers. TRAP: Assuming markers must be far apart wastes time; they can be adjacent, creating a zero-length middle section.

GOAL: Align the orange plus shape to cover all three scattered dots. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the plus center; Space cycles selection between objects. RULE: Only the orange plus needs moving; the X is a static obstacle. TRAP: Believing the missing white marker meant a bug, causing unnecessary checks instead of trusting the visual alignment.

ESTABLISHED: Two 5x5 blocks move in mirrored pairs. The center column is physically unreachable due to collision constraints. Painting is monotone; cleared cells stay cleared. FAILED: Attempting to paint the center column results in no-ops. Relying solely on a 20-move symmetry-fix walk did not clear the level. GOAL IS NOT: Painting every single cell on the 11x11 grid, as the center axis is impossible to cover. CONTROLS: Inputs move both blocks simultaneously in opposite directions. Moves that cause block collision or boundary exit are ignored.

GOAL: Connect the plug to the socket using specific colored wires. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the plug; clicking swaps wire positions. RULE: Only matching colors conduct power, creating a continuous chain from source to outlet. TRAP: Assuming any adjacent wires connect regardless of color, ignoring the critical color-matching constraint.

GOAL: Reduce the board to a single remaining peg. CONTROLS: Click a peg to select it, then click the highlighted landing spot to jump. RULE: A peg jumps over an adjacent neighbor into an empty space, removing the neighbor. TRAP: Assuming jumps are only horizontal; vertical jumps are equally valid and essential for clearing the board.

GOAL: Navigate a grid to place an object in a matching slot while managing a draining energy bar. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move one step; the bar depletes per step and refills only at specific rings. RULE: Touching a ring restores energy to full, allowing travel distances that exceed the starting capacity. TRAP: Ignoring refill rings forces impossible shortcuts; assuming the bar resets automatically causes failure before reaching the target.

GOAL: Move the player token into the ring to win. CONTROLS: Arrows move the player; clicking swaps the player with the block. RULE: The player must occupy the ring cell to complete the level. TRAP: Assuming the block must reach the ring wastes time; only the white player token counts.

GOAL: Clear the level by selecting the correct nodes in sequence. CONTROLS: Click to select or deselect grid nodes. RULE: Match node colors to the required pattern to clear the level. TRAP: Assuming grid coordinates align with visual row indices without verifying the actual data structure offset.

GOAL: Align two yellow markers to specific target spots on the board. CONTROLS: Clicking rows shifts their contents cyclically, with red and green rows moving in opposite directions. RULE: Each row operates on an independent cycle, allowing you to isolate and position items one row at a time. TRAP: Assuming all rows shift in the same direction causes misalignment, as red and green rows move oppositely.

GOAL: Match the grid colors to the pattern shown in the two mini-map glyphs. CONTROLS: Click a grid cell to toggle its color between blue and orange.
